# tosijs-ui

> Simple, robust web-components for use with tosijs or anything else.

Version 1.17.0-beta.4.

- Docs: https://ui.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-ui
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-ui

Each link below is the page's markdown. Drop `index.md` from it for the HTML page, where the examples run.
The whole corpus, as one markdown file: https://ui.tosijs.net/llms-full.txt

Live examples run inline on the shared page by default (not sandboxed):
each has its own `preview` element, but they share one tosijs module, so
`tosi()` state singletons are shared across every example on a page. This is
deliberate (it shows tosi isolation and lets you drive demos via the global
singleton). Namespace example state with unique top-level keys so examples
don't clobber each other; the `iframe` attribute isolates DOM/CSS, not state.

## Docs

- [tosijs-ui — robust, standards-based web components](https://ui.tosijs.net/index.md): Standards-based web components (data tables, dialogs, forms, rich text, carousels) built on tosijs: smaller and faster than React, with no virtual DOM.

## Components

- [Components](https://ui.tosijs.net/components/index.md): Custom elements for what HTML lacks or does badly: menus, selects, data tables, dialogs, tabs, code editors and more, built on web standards.
- [<tosi-3d> Babylon.js wrapper (deprecated) — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/babylon-3d/index.md): Deprecated: <tosi-3d> is a thin Babylon.js wrapper kept for compatibility. New 3D work should use the tosijs-3d package.
- [<tosi-affix> edge toolbars and badges — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/affix/index.md): <tosi-affix> attaches a toolbar, badge or caption to one edge of its content, laid out beside it rather than floated, so it never covers it.
- [carousel](https://ui.tosijs.net/carousel/index.md): A minimal carousel with optional arrows and dots, several items per page, looping, and auto-advance that holds still while someone is looking.
- [<tosi-code> CodeMirror 6 code editor — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/code-editor/index.md): <tosi-code> embeds a CodeMirror 6 editor for JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML and Markdown, with undo, a diff view and a change event.
- [<tosi-crud> list-and-edit screens — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/crud/index.md): <tosi-crud> pairs a searchable table with a schema-driven form over a store you supply (REST, IndexedDB or an array) for list-and-edit screens.
- [<tosi-dialog> modal dialogs and prompts — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/dialog/index.md): <tosi-dialog> wraps the native <dialog> element with an OK button, a footer slot, and promise-based alert, confirm and prompt helpers.
- [<tosi-diff> line-by-line text diff — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/diff/index.md): <tosi-diff> shows a unified, line-by-line diff between two strings, with removed and added lines marked, as in a code review.
- [editable-rect](https://ui.tosijs.net/editable-rect/index.md): <tosi-editable> adds handles to an absolutely positioned element to move, resize and rotate it, with optional grid and angle snapping.
- [<tosi-example> live code examples — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/component/index.md): <tosi-example> turns code blocks into live, editable examples with a preview, a console and inline tests, in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML or CSS.
- [<tosi-float> draggable floating panel — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/float/index.md): <tosi-float> is a minimally styled floating element that can be dragged, and that hides, stays or is removed when the window resizes.
- [gamepads](https://ui.tosijs.net/gamepad/index.md): Read gamepad and WebXR controller state in a compact form (buttons, triggers, thumbsticks and touch) for games and XR scenes.
- [<tosi-header> flex header bar — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/header/index.md): <tosi-header> is a flex header bar; compose it with elastic() and spacer() to place a title, links and menus where you want them.
- [SVG icon library and composition — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/icons/index.md): SVG icons as element creators (icons.chevronDown()), themeable with CSS variables, with a small language for composing new icons from old.
- [Icon composition playground — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/icon-composition/index.md): Experiment with the icon composition language: stack, recolour, rotate, scale and offset icons with short suffixes on their names.
- [iconSvg — icon markup without a DOM](https://ui.tosijs.net/icon-svg/index.md): iconSvg() returns an icon's SVG markup as a string and iconNames() lists them, with no DOM, for build scripts, server templates and ePubs.
- [make-icon-data](https://ui.tosijs.net/make-icon-data/index.md): A build tool that turns folders of SVG files into the icon-data module behind the tosijs-ui icon system, optimizing the paths as it goes.
- [<tosi-row>, <tosi-column>, <tosi-grid> layout — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/layout/index.md): <tosi-row>, <tosi-column> and <tosi-grid>: thin custom elements over CSS flexbox and grid for structural page layout.
- [<tosi-lottie> Lottie animation player — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/bodymovin-player/index.md): <tosi-lottie> plays Lottie (bodymovin) animations like an <img>: set src or json, and use the bodymovin API through its animation property.
- [<tosi-map> Mapbox GL map — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/mapbox/index.md): Embed an interactive Mapbox GL map as a custom element: set the token, style and coordinates as attributes, and use the map object for the rest.
- [<tosi-md> markdown viewer — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/markdown-viewer/index.md): <tosi-md> renders markdown from a src URL or from its own text, sanitizing the HTML by default, so you can show markdown anywhere on a page.
- [Pop-up, nested and drop menus — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/menu/index.md): Pop up a menu anywhere with popMenu() or <tosi-menu>: nested submenus, icons, keyboard shortcuts, and drop menus that accept drags.
- [notifications](https://ui.tosijs.net/notifications/index.md): postNotification() shows stacked toast notifications: info, success, warning, error or progress, timed or persistent, newest on top.
- [<tosi-palette> command palette — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/palette/index.md): <tosi-palette> is a command palette: a search field that opens a keyboard-driven modal of ranked results from sources you supply.
- [pocket bar](https://ui.tosijs.net/pocket-bar/index.md): A pocket toolbar: a single icon at rest that expands into a bar of your controls on hover or tap, then tucks away again.
- [popFloat](https://ui.tosijs.net/pop-float/index.md): popFloat() pops a floating element up beside a target, placing it to stay on screen, for popovers, pickers and other one-off overlays.
- [schema-form](https://ui.tosijs.net/schema-form/index.md): <tosi-schema-form> builds an editable, validated form from a JSON Schema, keeping its value, not the inputs, as the source of truth.
- [<tosi-sidenav> responsive sidebar — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/side-nav/index.md): <tosi-sidenav> shows a sidebar beside the content when there is room and hides it behind a toggle on small screens, as iPad apps do.
- [size-break](https://ui.tosijs.net/size-break/index.md): <tosi-sizebreak> swaps content by available size, such as a row of buttons that becomes a menu when space runs out.
- [<tosi-sizer> resize handle — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/sizer/index.md): <tosi-sizer> adds a bottom-right resize handle to a fixed-size element, so readers can drag it to a new size.
- [<tosi-table> virtual data table — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/data-table/index.md): A virtual data table for very large datasets: sortable, resizable, pinnable columns inferred from the data, keyboard navigation and row detail.
- [<tosi-tabs> tab panel — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/tab-selector/index.md): <tosi-tabs> builds a tab panel from its children's name attributes, with closeable tabs and methods to add or remove tabs.
- [Markdown tooltips — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/tooltip/index.md): Replace native title tooltips with styled ones that render markdown: call initTooltips() once, then use data-tooltip or title.

## Form Components

- [Form Components](https://ui.tosijs.net/form-components/index.md): Form-associated custom elements — inputs, selects, and editors that participate in native <form> (and <tosi-form>) submission and validation.
- [color input field](https://ui.tosijs.net/color-input/index.md): <tosi-color> is a colour input that also edits opacity, so it can produce translucent colours that the native colour picker cannot.
- [<tosi-filter> query and filter builder — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/filter-builder/index.md): <tosi-filter> builds array filter functions from a Finder-style query editor, with extensible filter types and a state you can save as JSON.
- [<tosi-form> forms with native validation — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/form/index.md): <tosi-form> and <tosi-field> build forms with native client-side validation and a submit callback that receives the form's values.
- [<tosi-month> calendar and date picker — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/month/index.md): <tosi-month> shows a calendar month and, when selectable, lets readers pick a date or a date range: a friendlier date picker.
- [password strength](https://ui.tosijs.net/password-strength/index.md): Wrap an <input> in <tosi-password-strength> to rate a password as it is typed and securely check whether it appears in known breaches.
- [<tosi-rating> star rating input — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/rating/index.md): <tosi-rating> is a form-associated rating input drawn with icons, with half steps, custom icons and sizes, that behaves like an <input>.
- [rich text](https://ui.tosijs.net/rich-text/index.md): <tosi-rich-text> is a small, extensible WYSIWYG editor with a customizable toolbar, editing its own contents or a value you set.
- [search-field](https://ui.tosijs.net/search-field/index.md): <tosi-search-field> suggests refinements as you type and turns them into tags, for Finder-style searches with power operators.
- [segmented select](https://ui.tosijs.net/segmented/index.md): <tosi-segmented> is a form-associated segmented control for choosing one value or several, with icons and labels.
- [<tosi-select> styleable select menu — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/select/index.md): <tosi-select> replaces <select> with a styleable menu that supports icons, separators, submenus, editable values and missing options.
- [tag-list](https://ui.tosijs.net/tag-list/index.md): An editable list of tags with suggestions, built on standard inputs and form-associated, so it submits like any other field.

## Helper Libraries

- [Helper Libraries](https://ui.tosijs.net/helper-libraries/index.md): General purpose utilities and behaviors — routing, theming, localization, sorting, drag-and-drop, and other building blocks.
- [<tosi-ab> A/B tests and feature flags — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/ab-test/index.md): <tosi-ab> shows or hides content by condition, so you can run A/B tests or feature flags by setting AbTest.conditions.
- [drag & drop](https://ui.tosijs.net/drag-and-drop/index.md): Make HTML5 drag and drop usable: one init() call highlights compatible drop zones as a drag starts, including zones added mid-drag.
- [hash-state](https://ui.tosijs.net/hash-state/index.md): Key-value state in the page's URL hash: shareable, bookmarkable, and back/forward work without you writing any of it.
- [live-theme](https://ui.tosijs.net/live-theme/index.md): A live theme editor: adjust tosijs-ui theme colours and watch every component update instantly, then read or set the values from code.
- [localize](https://ui.tosijs.net/localize/index.md): Localize an interface: localize() for strings, <tosi-localized> for markup, and <tosi-locale-picker> so readers can choose the language.
- [makeSorter](https://ui.tosijs.net/make-sorter/index.md): Build an array sort callback from a function that returns the keys to sort by, with a direction per key, so a multi-key sort is one line.
- [naturalCompare](https://ui.tosijs.net/natural-compare/index.md): Comparing values the way a reader expects, for sorting tables, navs and lists.
- [Client-side router for single-page apps — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/router/index.md): A lightweight client-side router for single-page apps, with named parameters, hash routing, and several named views per route.
- [scriptTag & styleSheet](https://ui.tosijs.net/via-tag/index.md): scriptTag() and styleSheet() load a classic script or stylesheet from a CDN and return a promise, much like import() for older libraries.
- [Theme, CSS variables and dark mode — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/theme/index.md): The tosijs-ui theme: CSS variables for spacing, colour and type shared by every component, with dark mode computed from your colours.
- [trackDrag](https://ui.tosijs.net/track-drag/index.md): trackDrag() follows a mouse or touch drag with one callback that reports the offset, for resize handles, sliders and draggable parts.
- [valueRenderer](https://ui.tosijs.net/value-renderer/index.md): valueRenderer() turns a short type string into a formatter for numbers, currency, bytes or booleans, each with a default alignment.

## Documentation System

- [Documentation System](https://ui.tosijs.net/documentation-system/index.md): tosijs-ui/site: turn markdown and doc comments into a static, pre-rendered documentation site with live, self-testing examples, an ePub and print.
- [Adopting the doc system](https://ui.tosijs.net/adopting-the-doc-system/index.md): Your first hour with tosijs-ui/site: the minimum that works, how to tell it works, and four failures that still serve every page.
- [One Source](https://ui.tosijs.net/one-source-every-artifact/index.md): How one corpus of doc comments and markdown becomes a static SEO site, a live playground, an ePub, a PDF and llms.txt from a single build.
- [Doc-Site System](https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-site-system/index.md): How tosijs-ui's static, pre-rendered, hydrating documentation-site system works — and how to adopt it (tosijs-ui/site) in your own project.
- [doc-system](https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-system/index.md): <tosi-doc-system> hydrates pre-rendered static doc pages into a fast single-page doc browser, keeping full HTML for search engines and no-JS readers.
- [doc-browser](https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-browser/index.md): createDocBrowser() renders a documentation corpus as a searchable browser with live, self-testing examples: a lighter alternative to Storybook.
- [extractDocs() doc corpus extractor — tosijs-ui](https://ui.tosijs.net/docs/index.md): extractDocs() collects markdown files and doc comments from source code into one docs.json corpus, the input to the doc browser and static site.
- [highlight-block](https://ui.tosijs.net/highlight-block/index.md): <tosi-highlight> syntax-highlights code that arrives at runtime, such as a fetched snippet or a chat message, without loading a code editor.
- [highlight-styles](https://ui.tosijs.net/highlight-styles/index.md): The syntax-highlighting token colours as a stylesheet you can import and retheme, for code highlighted outside <tosi-highlight>.
- [data client](https://ui.tosijs.net/data-client/index.md): Open and save a project's data files from a dev-server page, for in-browser tools such as level or scene editors, optionally committing each save.

## Appendices

- [Appendices](https://ui.tosijs.net/appendices/index.md): Upgrading tosijs-ui across breaking releases, and the release-notes tool that builds its changelog from commit messages.
- [release-notes](https://ui.tosijs.net/release-notes/index.md): tosijs-release-notes builds CHANGELOG sections from tagged bullets in commit messages, and fails a release when one is left unwritten.
- [Migrating from older versions](https://ui.tosijs.net/migrating/index.md): Breaking changes in tosijs-ui releases and what to change when you upgrade past them, from the xinjs-ui rename to the current release.
